sovereign_country.strategic_role: 极速离岸证券与外汇交易商持牌（VFSC）、轻资产免税出海

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Out-of-Gauge (OOG) Heavy Industrial Project Cargo Logistics

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Vanuatu (Port Vila; unitary national jurisdiction, no sub-state tax distinction)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid — English Common Law foundation with residual French Civil Law influence; Constitution of the Republic of Vanuatu 1980; codified commercial statutes including the International Companies Act [Cap. 222]
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations (PACER) Plus — in force 13 December 2020
Agreement Establishing the World Trade Organization (WTO) — Vanuatu accession effective 24 August 2012
Framework Agreement on Trade and Economic Cooperation between the Government of Vanuatu and the Government of Australia
Agreement on Trade and Economic Cooperation between the Government of Vanuatu and the Government of New Zealand
Note: Vanuatu imposes no national income tax regime and therefore maintains no comprehensive double taxation agreement network.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: International Companies Act [Cap. 222] (name clearance, registered agent, corporate records); Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 24 of 2016, as amended (customer due diligence, beneficial ownership, suspicious transaction reporting); Financial Intelligence Unit (Vanuatu FIU) obligations; VFSC Regulatory Rules for Licensed Registered Agents and Trustees; the registered agent must identify and verify every beneficial owner, maintain UBO records at the registered office, and disclose to the FIU upon lawful demand.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of passport or government-issued national ID of each director, shareholder and ultimate beneficial owner (Vanuatu is not a Hague Apostille state; consular legalization required)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National passport or ID issuing authority of the holder's country of residence

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Conduct / Police Clearance of each director and material UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National police or criminal record authority of country of residence

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified corporate package of any corporate shareholder (Certificate of Incorporation, Memorandum and Articles, board resolution appointing signatories, UBO declaration)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Home jurisdiction company registry and notary public

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all directors, shareholders, UBOs and authorized signatories against OFAC SDN, UN Security Council Consolidated List, UK HM Treasury, EU consolidated sanctions and Vanuatu FIU designated persons lists before incorporation; ongoing transaction monitoring with risk-based enhanced due diligence triggered by any PEP, adverse-media or sanctioned-jurisdiction nexus. For the Low_Risk_Standard tier applicable to out-of-gauge project cargo logistics, standard CDD with a 25% UBO threshold applies; Milestone_Wire and Letter_of_Credit settlement rails must be screened for country-of-origin, transshipment and cargo-destination sanctions exposure.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) Companies and International Companies Registry — name reservation is effected by a licensed registered agent through the VFSC internal e-registry; public availability searchable via the VFSC corporate register at www.vfsc.vu.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Statutory languages are English and French (Bislama recognized nationally). Registered names must be in Latin script; English or French vocabulary is permitted; the word 'Limited' (or abbreviations 'Ltd' / 'Ltee') must terminate the name; no vernacular-script transliteration is filed for the registered name; the VFSC compares exact textual match and near-phonetic equivalents in the Roman alphabet.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Any token implying sovereign connection, royal patronage or regulated financial activity; prior approval of the Reserve Bank of Vanuatu or the relevant Minister is required for regulated tokens.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon VFSC rejection, the licensed registered agent may file a written reconsideration request with the Registrar of International Companies within 14 calendar days stating distinctive grounds and attaching additional clearance evidence (e.g., ministerial approval for sensitive words). If reconsideration fails, the applicant may re-submit a new name with the same incorporation application or pursue judicial review in the Supreme Court of Vanuatu; concurrently, the agent should reserve an alternative name to avoid delay in issuance of the certificate of incorporation.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible in substance — the International Company must maintain a statutory registered office in Vanuatu at the premises of a licensed registered agent, which serves as the legal address and records repository; the physical office of the registered agent satisfies the statutory mandate. For an out-of-gauge heavy project cargo logistics enterprise without Vanuatu operational presence, no separately leased premises are required and no Vanuatu-sourced revenue may be derived; board and accounting records may be kept electronically offshore provided statutory copies reside at the registered office.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Below 5% probability in the first incorporation year for a Standard low-risk, non-Vanuatu-operating logistics vehicle; unannounced VFSC or FIU inspections rise to an estimated 10% where nominee directors, citizenship-by-investment-linked identity documents, or high-risk payment corridors are detected; any inspection is executed at the registered agent's office.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: VFSC name clearance application and availability search
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (settled via licensed registered agent)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory VFSC tariff; prevailing agent handling charge

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: VFSC incorporation filing fee — International Company, nil minimum authorized capital
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory fee schedule under the International Companies Act [Cap. 222]

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Licensed registered agent and registered office service (annual)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark (USD 700–1,200) for standard International Company maintenance

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: UBO/KYC/AML compliance file preparation, PEP and sanctions screening
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark per single corporate structure

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization and consular legalization of passport, police clearance and corporate documents (3-document bundle)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary public and Vanuatu consular / diplomatic mission
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing consular statutory fees and notary tariff in country of origin

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Preparation of Memorandum and Articles of Association / Charter (custom out-of-gauge project cargo logistics objects clause)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for bespoke Vanuatu IC charter

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: VFSC certificate of good standing / registered office extract and expedited dispatch
International courier of legalized onboarding documents (Port Vila DHL service)

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act (Act No. 32 of 1993), as amended, together with the International Companies Regulations 1993; principally sections 6 (incorporation), 13 (powers), 16 (name restrictions), 21 (share capital), 31 (registered office), 32 (registered agent), 48 (directors), and 66 (first directors and resolutions).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) — International Companies Registry
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Registration of an International Company together with the Memorandum and Articles of Association and statutory declarations of compliance
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital is prescribed by the International Companies Act; no escrow or paid-in capital deposit is required, although the registered agent must record the issued capital and confirm receipt of any consideration for subscribed shares.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED that the subscribers' allotment of shares be confirmed and the subscribed shares be recorded; that the registered office and registered agent proposed in the application be approved and adopted; that the persons named as director(s), the corporate secretary and the resident agent be appointed; that the execution of banking, freight-forwarding and project-logistics agreements be authorized; that the seal and electronic signature protocols be adopted; that the binder of statutory registers be kept at the registered office; and that the directors instruct the registered agent to file all necessary declarations with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) International Companies Registry through a licensed registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name reservation request to the VFSC International Companies Registry through a licensed Vanuatu registered agent. The proposed company name must be checked against the national register for conflicts, prohibited words, or names implying government or financial-services licensing. Upon approval, the name is reserved for the incorporation.
required_dossiers: Written engagement instructions to the licensed registered agent
Proposed name and alternative name list
Identification of promoters and beneficial owners
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused due to similarity or prohibited wording, the applicant may file a fresh reservation with an alternative name or challenge the refusal by written submission to the VFSC with consent letters or supporting evidence of distinctive use.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and pre-notarization of constitutional documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed registered agent under the International Companies Act
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Instruct the registered agent to draft the Memorandum and Articles of Association, issue subscriber share application forms, and arrange for notarization or certification of documents. The registered agent conducts KYC and AML screening on all proposed shareholders, directors, and beneficial owners before filing.
required_dossiers: Memorandum and Articles of Association in final draft form
Certified copy of passport and proof of residential address for each director, shareholder, and beneficial owner
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Deficiencies in the constitutional documents are cured by the registered agent preparing corrected notarized versions and re-submitting them to VFSC within the statutory review window.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of incorporation application and payment of government fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent submits the executed incorporation application, Memorandum and Articles of Association, consents of the registered office and registered agent, and the government filing fee to the VFSC. Upon verification, VFSC issues the Certificate of Incorporation, at which time the International Company is legally constituted.
required_dossiers: Prescribed application form for registration of an International Company
Executed Memorandum and Articles of Association
Consent of the registered office provider
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried for full or partial defects, the registered agent submits an explanation, amends the relevant form, pays any additional search fee, and re-files the corrected application.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Appointment of first directors, secretary, and registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: First board of directors of the International Company
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Following incorporation, the subscribers execute a written resolution appointing the first directors and secretary. The registered agent's appointment and registered office address are ratified by the board, and any prescribed notice of director and officeholder particulars is filed with VFSC.
required_dossiers: Written consent to act as director
Written consent to act as secretary
Notice of director or officeholder particulars
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If VFSC raises a discrepancy in director or secretary details, the company files a corrective statutory declaration and amended notice through the registered agent without loss of incorporation status.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Establishment of statutory registers and corporate book records
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the register of members, register of directors and secretary, register of charges, and minute book; issue share certificates; and keep all statutory registers at the registered office in Vanuatu or at the registered agent's office. Record the first board resolutions and maintain the certificate of incorporation with the corporate records.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Any omission or error in the registers is corrected by board resolution and a rectification memorandum; the registered agent files a correcting declaration if the VFSC requires an official record change.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Confirmation of tax-exempt status and external business profile activation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission and, where applicable, Vanuatu Department of Customs and Inland Revenue
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Confirm that the International Company is exempt from Vanuatu income tax, VAT, goods tax, and stamp duty on transactions conducted outside Vanuatu, and that no domestic business is being conducted. Prepare a corporate profile pack for bank account opening, letter-of-credit facilities, and project cargo counterparty due diligence.
required_dossiers: Tax-exempt status confirmation letter from the registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a bank or counterparty questions the tax-exempt status, the registered agent obtains from VFSC a formal certificate confirming the company's International Company classification and absence of Vanuatu domestic tax exposure.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: No industrial licensing authority applies to an offshore International Company in Vanuatu; the company is prohibited from conducting domestic physical business in Vanuatu and therefore is not eligible for an inward industrial or manufacturing licence.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not applicable — International Companies operate purely offshore; any heavy-haul or project-cargo physical operations must be performed through foreign counterparties, special-purpose vehicles, or in the destination jurisdiction under its applicable transport licensing regime.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Vanuatu Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt from EIA review because no land-based facility, fixed installation, waste-generating operation, or material change of land use is established in Vanuatu under this corporate structure.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No Vanuatu discharge or emissions standards are triggered at incorporation stage; if a future domestic branch or transshipment yard is contemplated, the company would need to comply with the Waste Management and Pollution Control regulations, including marine discharge limits, waste manifesting, and OOG cargo storage requirements.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not applicable at formation stage as no Vanuatu physical workplace is established; should a future logistics depot or loading yard be formed, the entity would be required to obtain fire safety certification from the Vanuatu National Fire Services, structural load clearance for heavy-lift cranes, and workplace compliance certification under the Vanuatu labour code.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Customs and Inland Revenue (VCIR), Department of Customs and Inland Revenue, Ministry of Finance and Economic Management, Port Vila (official portal: www.customs.gov.vu); corporate registry and International Company supervision: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Port Vila (www.vfsc.vu).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Step 1: Incorporate the International Company (IC) under the International Companies Act (Cap 222) via a licensed VFSC registered agent (memorandum/articles, registered office and registered agent in Port Vila, directors and shareholders registers). Step 2: Obtain a VFSC Certificate of Good Standing; no income tax registration is required because Vanuatu levies no income tax on ICs. Step 3: If the IC imports OOG equipment or clears export zero-rated supplies through Vanuatu ports, obtain a Customs Client/Importer Code in ASYCUDA World by filing the Customs Client Registration Form with the incorporation certificate, VFSC good-standing certificate, passport copies of directors, agent confirmation and bank reference. Step 4: Register for VAT with the Commissioner (form R1) only if taxable supplies in Vanuatu exceed the VUV 5,000,000 threshold, or voluntarily to recover input VAT; the Commissioner issues an 8-digit VAT/TIN number and VAT registration certificate. Step 5: Maintain the annual VFSC return and entity fee; no corporate tax return is filed because no income tax is in force.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Tax_Exempt_Zone — the IC is statutorily exempt from all Vanuatu taxes on income, assets, distributions, capital gains and stamp duty (International Companies Act (Cap 222) s.130 exemption, routinely evidenced by a Minister-issued exemption certificate covering the statutory exemption period, commonly marketed as a 20-year guarantee); Vanuatu currently imposes no corporate income tax, no withholding tax, no capital gains tax and no payroll tax on any company; the draft 2023 proposals (10% CIT on turnover above VUV 15 million and a 2% service charge) were deferred by the Council of Ministers in February 2024 and are not in force; VAT (12.5%), customs duty and municipal licence fees continue to apply to onshore imports and consumption, but an IC is prohibited from domestic trading in Vanuatu, so its OOG project cargo operations are offshore/export-scope only.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No US-style check-the-box or elective entity classification exists under Vanuatu law; the IC tax-exempt status is automatic and non-elective. Available elections: (i) voluntary VAT registration to recover input VAT attributable to zero-rated export services; (ii) election between invoice-basis and payment-basis VAT accounting with the Commissioner's consent; (iii) election to file customs entries through an in-house ASYCUDA user account or a licensed customs broker; (iv) temporary-import bond election for foreign heavy-lift equipment with re-export within the statutory bond period under the Customs Act; and (v) application for the IC tax exemption certificate for production to banks, L/C issuing banks and charterers.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT Act No. 12 of 1998, consolidated as VAT Act [Cap 241]), a credit-invoice-method VAT administered by the Commissioner of Inland Revenue; customs duties and export duties (rarely applied) under the Customs Act; no GST and no sales-and-use tax exists.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VUV 5,000,000 (five million vatu) of annual taxable turnover in any 12-month period; registration is mandatory once the threshold is met or is reasonably expected to be met; a non-resident IC whose Vanuatu supplies are exclusively zero-rated is not obliged to register but may do so voluntarily; importers must hold a Customs Client Code and pay import VAT at the border at the standard 12.5% rate.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance, no mandatory government-authorisation e-invoicing API, and no digital stamping regime exists in Vanuatu as of the reporting date. VAT tax invoices must be issued within 28 days of the time of supply and contain the 14 statutory particulars (supplier/recipient names and TIN, description, quantity, unit price, VAT amount, zero-rating citation). All export and import declarations are filed electronically through ASYCUDA World (UNCTAD EDI) and must be customs-cleared before goods are laden or released; OOG heavy-lift consignments require pre-lodgement of the export manifest, stowage plan, cargo survey certificate, and overweight/over-dimensional verification at Port Vila or Luganville port.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Goods: a supply of export goods (including OOG modules, cranes and heavy machinery) is zero-rated under s.19 of the VAT Act [Cap 241] where the IC exports the goods to a place outside Vanuatu, the export entry is lodged in ASYCUDA World, and the goods are removed from Vanuatu within the statutory period of 28 days from the time of supply (or such longer period as the Commissioner approves for project logistics). Services: a supply of services is zero-rated where supplied to a non-resident foreign principal and (a) the services are physically performed or benefitted outside Vanuatu, or (b) the services are ancillary to exported goods, including ocean and air international freight, port stevedoring, project cargo forwarding, chartering, survey and pre-shipment inspection of export cargo. The IC must obtain and retain the export evidence before claiming the 0% rate; input VAT attributable to zero-rated exports is refundable through the periodic VAT return (input-credit/refund mechanism).
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (ASYCUDA World SAD Form) validated and cleared for the OOG heavy-lift consignment
Bill of Lading (ocean liner or charter-party bill for out-of-gauge project cargo) or Air Waybill naming the foreign destination
Inward Remittance Certificate / bank SWIFT MT103 or Letter of Credit negotiation advice proving receipt of export proceeds
Commercial invoice (VAT 0% basis), packing list and OOG cargo survey report with dimensions, gross weight and stowage certificate
Insurance certificate (marine cargo/liability) for the international transit; freight contract, charter party or booking note linking the supply to the foreign principal
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The Commissioner may disallow the 0% rate and claw back refunded or credited VAT plus interest at 20% per annum where the export documentation bundle is incomplete, inconsistent or untimely; penalty tax of up to 150% of the VAT evaded applies for negligence or fraud (VAT Act [Cap 241]), and officers may face criminal prosecution (fine and/or up to 2 years imprisonment) for fraudulent zero-rating declarations; the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit can impose freezing, disgorgement or anti-money-laundering penalties for false trade invoicing; reassessment is open for 5 years from the end of the tax period and is unlimited in cases of forgery or fraud. Vanuatu imposes no exchange-control repatriation rule, so the 180-day collection milestone follows trade-finance practice, Incoterms and L/C tenors; overdue export proceeds may trigger substance and commercial-reality audits by the Commissioner and VFSC.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Vanuatu maintains a liberal exchange control regime. The Vanuatu Vatu (VUV) is fully convertible on both current and capital account transactions. There are no exchange control regulations applicable to non-resident-owned International Companies (ICs), and no restrictions on inward capital injections, dividend distributions, or profit remittance to foreign shareholders. Profit remittance may be effected directly through the commercial banking system without prior central bank approval, subject only to standard bank due diligence and tax clearance confirmation (tax-exempt IC status).
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Vanuatu imposes no statutory surrender requirement for export proceeds. Export receipts may be retained freely in VUV or any foreign currency, credited directly to the exporter's operational account without any mandatory conversion ratio or specified repatriation timeline. The only compliance expectation is that receipts pass through the formal banking sector for AML/CFT traceability.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low-to-Medium. Offshore digital EMIs and virtual account providers are not licensed depository institutions in Vanuatu and cannot serve as primary treasury rails for project cargo settlement. They may be used only as supplementary collection gateways where the underlying receivable is pre-funded or where the EMI maintains a correspondent account with a licensed Vanuatu bank. The legal constraint is that no entity may hold client funds or perform money transmission without a banking licence or a valid Electronic Money Institution authorisation under the Reserve Bank of Vanuatu Act, which is not available to purely offshore fintech providers.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical attendance is generally required for at least one director or an authorised signatory at the Vanuatu branch or a recognised correspondent representative. Some banks accept remote onboarding where the International Company (IC) uses an in-country registered agent and the ultimate beneficial owner and directors complete video-based identity verification, supported by certified copies of passports and proof of address. However, the first board resolution authorising the bank mandate must be notarised and apostilled. Where an account class involves capital escrow or letter-of-credit backstopping, most Vanuatu credit committees require at least one face-to-face interview at the bank premises or at a regional commercial office.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Complete statutory declaration of trust/control chain, notarised corporate register extract, UBO passport copies with notarisation, proof of source of wealth (2-year bank statements, contract ledger), and tax-office tax-exempt confirmation letter.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-volume OOG project cargo invoicing with large milestone wires
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed project logistics contracts, carbonised bill of lading or freight forwarder certificate, supplier/shipper commercial invoices, bank reference letters from the existing treasury bank, and a projected cash-flow forecast matched to milestone schedules.

Commodity/cargo routing logs, Incoterms declaration, vessel flag and IMO number, consolidated sanctions-screening certificate from a licensed screening provider, and contractual indemnities / end-user attestations confirming no sanctioned counterparty involvement.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Use of Letter of Credit (LC) instruments with non-bank project sponsors
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Issuing bank confirmation of SWIFT MT700, full LC text with UCP600 conformity statement, purchase order / tender award letter, and evidence of compliance with the Vanuatu International Companies Act on transactional borrowing / treasury authority.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound capital injection should be routed via SWIFT MT103 or MT202 ADV from the parent group treasury bank to the Vanuatu IC's operational VUV or USD account held at a licensed reserve bank-cleared commercial bank. The wire must use purpose code 'G' (general business / capital contribution) or an explicit narrative stating 'IC Shareholder Capital Injection – ISIC 5229 Project Cargo Services' to avoid exchange-control misclassification. For LC-backed capital injections, the LC issuing bank should advise the Vanuatu beneficiary bank on MT710/MT720 with a clear LC reference; the destination account must match the registered beneficiary name exactly. The receiving bank will obtain a statement of purpose and may require the shareholder resolution approving the capital contribution to be furnished before credit is irrevocably released.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound trade settlements for subcontractor heavy-haul logistics, ocean freight, crane rental, port handling, and OOG transport services should be executed through the domestic clearing rail of SWIFT MT103 direct transfers from the Vanuatu IC's operational account to the counterparty's beneficiary bank. For larger milestone settlements, a commercial Letter of Credit (MT700 issued by a first-class international bank; MT710/MT720 for assignment) is the preferred rail. The commercial LC route must name the Vanuatu logistics IC as beneficiary and require presentation of: full set clean on-board ocean bill of lading, consular or transhipment certificate, packing list, weight certificate, and the project milestone completion certificate. VUV-denominated operational disbursements may clear through the Reserve Bank Vanuatu real-time gross settlement (RTGS) system; all FX-funded disbursements require underlying contract evidence to qualify for bank-offering cleared transfers without TCF (tax clearance form).
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Vanuatu Vatu (VUV) cash-settled FX forwards with licensed domestic banks for fixed-term project milestone coverage
Cross-currency swaps (VUV/USD and VUV/EUR) involving a Vanuatu-licensed bank and an offshore counterparty bank, governed by ISDA master agreement

Offshore non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) on VUV used strictly for hedging bona fide project cargo receivables, arranged through a non-resident licensed fintech bank broker, provided the underlying trade contract is documented
Zero-premium and premium-bearing vanilla currency options (USD/VUV) as approved by the Reserve Bank of Vanuatu for trade-related hedging only

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Government License Renewal Fee (International Company annual franchise/registration fee)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Registry of International Companies
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due on the anniversary of incorporation; 30-day grace period from the due date
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Statutory late-payment surcharge applies from the day after the due date; non-payment for approximately 90 days exposes the company to administrative strike-off and dissolution by the VFSC Registrar, with consequent loss of legal capacity to contract or pursue legal proceedings.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return / Confirmation Statement (Explicitly Not Required for International Companies)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: None (VFSC does not collect annual returns or confirmation statements from International Companies)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Not applicable - no annual return filing obligation arises under the International Companies Act
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: None - no penalty attaches to a filing that is not statutorily due; the company remains in good standing solely upon payment of the annual government license fee.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Registered Agent's Annual Return / Omnibus List of Represented International Companies (agent-side filing)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Licensing and Compliance Unit
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually per the VFSC's prescribed licensed-agent compliance cycle, typically on a calendar-year-end basis
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure by the licensed registered agent to file may result in monetary penalty, suspension, or revocation of the agent's licence; the represented International Company's good-standing certificate may be suspended pending agent compliance.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: None. Vanuatu International Companies are statutorily exempt from mandatory audit, independent auditor appointment, and financial statement filing irrespective of revenue, assets, or share capital. No audit trigger thresholds apply.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No prescribed statutory accounting framework. The International Companies Act requires the company to keep, in the custody of its registered agent, accounting records sufficient to accurately explain transactions and enable the financial position to be ascertained. IFRS or simple accrual-basis local/internal GAAP is commonly adopted voluntarily where lenders, insurers, or project counterparties require financial reporting.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: No annual UBO confirmation is filed with the VFSC. Beneficial ownership information is held confidentially by the licensed registered agent and disclosed to the VFSC or Vanuatu financial intelligence authorities upon lawful demand. The registered agent must refresh beneficial ownership and know-your-client data upon any share transfer and on a periodic cycle of at least every 12 months. Shares of an International Company are issued in registered form; a transfer is effective only upon entry in the Register of Members.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 800 - USD 1,500 per annum for licensed Vanuatu registered agent, registered office, and compliance support services
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not applicable (statutorily audit-exempt); voluntary IFRS audit for project finance, letter of credit, or counterparty due diligence purposes typically USD 3,500 - USD 8,500 per engagement

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Vanuatu levies no corporate income tax. A Vanuatu International Company (VU IC) is expressly exempt under the International Companies Act [Cap 222] from all Vanuatu taxes on income or profits, capital gains, dividends, estate/inheritance duties, and stamp duty on share transfers. The effective tax rate is therefore 0%; no preferential deduction or tax holiday is required.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Not applicable for corporate income tax: Vanuatu has no CIT return form and no CIT filing portal. The only recurring public filing is the VU IC annual return and annual government fee submitted through the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) online company registry.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: No CIT return frequency. The VFSC annual return is filed once per year for administrative and fee purposes.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: No CIT statutory deadline exists. The VFSC annual return and annual fee must be filed by the anniversary of incorporation or the renewal date indicated by the VFSC; failure triggers late fees and potential strike-off.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: There is no line box for income, deductions, credits, or losses because the VU IC has no corporate income tax filing obligation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident shareholders and directors file no Vanuatu income tax documents and hold no Vanuatu tax registration for CIT purposes.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Annual return records the registered office, registered agent, shareholders, directors, and deemed compliance statements for the VU IC.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The registered agent in Vanuatu files on behalf of the non-resident owners; non-resident directors may be named in the register but have no Vanuatu tax declaration.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late VFSC annual return triggers a late filing fee, possible daily default penalties, restoration costs, and ultimately administrative strike-off of the International Company. Non-compliance with the International Companies Act [Cap 222] can expose the company and its registered agent to further monetary penalties imposed by the VFSC.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% — no withholding tax is imposed on dividends paid by a Vanuatu International Company.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: No comprehensive double taxation agreement is currently in force for Vanuatu; tax information exchange agreements do not create withholding relief. Because the statutory dividend withholding rate is zero, no treaty claim, no Vanuatu tax residence certificate, and no submission of a TRC is required for outbound distributions. In the hypothetical presence of a DTA, the beneficial owner would still need to provide a certificate of residence to the paying agent, but Vanuatu's DTA network is effectively absent.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory rates: 0% for both cross-border royalties and interest. With no DTAs, separate treaty rates are not applicable; payments can be made gross without Vanuatu withholding tax.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: None (VUV 0): Vanuatu has no corporate income tax and no statutory transfer pricing documentation regime. A VU IC is not required to prepare OECD-style Local File, Master File, or country-by-country report in Vanuatu. Foreign-parent compliance obligations are governed solely by the foreign jurisdiction.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Vanuatu has adopted Economic Substance Regulations aligned with OECD standards. A VU IC carrying on a 'relevant activity' must demonstrate economic substance in Vanuatu, including a physical office, employees, and core income-generating activities locally, and must file an annual ESR return. The out-of-gauge heavy project cargo logistics business may be treated as a distribution and service centre or may otherwise be tested for a relevant activity. A passive holding company or low-risk logistics vehicle must still avoid functioning as a shell; substantive activities conducted outside Vanuatu will not satisfy the ESR test.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax evasion / abuse of zero-tax status
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the Vanuatu International Company as a sham conduit to evade foreign tax: fabricating logistics invoices, backdating contracts, misdescribing OOG heavy haul services, or concealing the true beneficial owner of project cargo revenue.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: False declarations and deceptive filings under the International Companies Act [Cap 222] attract VFSC administrative penalties, potential strike-off, retroactive loss of exemption where relevant, and referral to Vanuatu prosecution authorities.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be held personally liable where the corporate veil is pierced for fraud or sham. Courts can order civil restitution of diverted profits, impose asset seizure and travel bans, and directors may face imprisonment in associated fraud or money laundering prosecutions.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell company / absence of economic substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining a VU IC with only a nominee registered agent, no physical office in Vanuatu, no Vanuatu-based staff, no local books and records, and no filed ESR notification while claiming active heavy-cargo logistics operations.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Sanctions under Vanuatu's Economic Substance Regulations and VFSC enforcement practice include administrative financial penalties, enforced strike-off, disqualification of the registered agent, and adverse exchange-of-information notifications to treaty partners.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and the registered agent who knowingly permit the shell structure may be disqualified from managing VFSC-regulated entities, ordered to pay restoration costs and penalties, and face civil liability for losses sustained by counterparties or foreign tax authorities.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Exploiting project cargo payment rails (milestone wires and letters of credit) through over-invoicing of heavy equipment, fictitious demurrage, false voyage milestones, undisclosed beneficiary changes, or splitting payments to evade Vanuatu transaction reporting thresholds.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Violations of the Financial Transactions Reporting Act and VFSC AML Rules carry significant fines, asset forfeiture, and imprisonment of up to 12 years for substantive money laundering; the VU IC may also be struck off.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors, compliance officers, and the money-laundering reporting officer can be criminally liable for knowing involvement or negligent failure to report suspicious transactions. Remedies include confiscation of proceeds, travel restrictions, and custodial sentences.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the International Company to hold client deposits, issue guarantees or finance cargo contracts, or operate a payment/settlement scheme without a VFSC financial services licence, despite the stated scope being ISIC 5229 logistics.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Carrying on regulated financial business without a licence breaches the Financial Services Commission Act and the International Companies Act; the VFSC can issue cease-and-desist orders, impose monetary penalties, wind up the company, and refer the matter for prosecution.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors face personal civil liability to customers and counterparties, disqualification from managing VFSC-licensed entities, and criminal sanctions including fines and imprisonment for knowingly conducting unlicensed financial business.
